# Konstantinos Papaioannou

> I am a final-year Computer Science Ph.D. student at IMDEA Software Institute, advised by Thaleia Dimitra Doudali, working on Systems for Machine Learning. My research focuses on making inference serving efficient for multimodal LLMs and other foundation models, through request scheduling, KV cache management, and pipeline-aware serving. Previously, I received my Diploma in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the National Technical University of Athens. During my last year, I completed my Diploma thesis on "Optimizing ML Workflows by Integrating a Feature Store into Kubeflow", supervised by Nectarios Koziris and Vangelis Koukis. I am looking for industry research and engineering roles starting in October 2027.

Generated from https://kon-pap.github.io/ on 2026-10-23.

## Research topics

- ML Inference Serving Systems
- Multimodal Inference Scheduling and KV Cache Management
- Pipeline-Aware Serving for Any-to-Any Models

## Education

- PhD in CS, IMDEA Software Institute (Oct 2022 - Sept 2027 (exp.))
- MEng in ECE, National Technical University of Athens (2017 - 2022)

## Experience

- Research Intern @ IBM (Jun 2026 - Sept 2026): Worked with the Next Generation Systems team on serving geospatial foundation models at scale, using vLLM and llm-d.
- Thesis Intern @ Arrikto (Oct 2021 - Sept 2022): Transformed Feast, an open-source feature store, into a cloud-native client-server system integrated with Kubeflow on Kubernetes.
